player.note: Player character. Texture test.png is missing, so autoColor paints body parts by bone.

treadmillTier1.note: Treadmill level 1 (grey/red, +2/step). Runner faces +Z; belt surface at y = 0.55.

treadmillTier2.note: Treadmill level 2 (silver/green). Runner faces +Z; belt surface at y = 0.55.

treadmillTier3.note: Treadmill level 3 (white/blue, like the reference). Runner faces +Z; belt surface at y = 0.55.

treadmillTier4.note: Treadmill levels 4-5 (gold, looping rail). Runner faces +Z; belt surface at y = 0.55.

guardian_forest.note: Forest guardian (Broody Hen), ~5 units tall, faces +Z. Name leg/wing bones LegL1/LegR1/ArmL1/ArmR1 (or Mixamo names) to get the walk animation.

nest.note: Egg nest. Eggs sit at y = 0.35.

egg_forest_speckled.note: Speckled Egg (Common). 1 unit tall at scale 1, bottom at y = 0; the game also scales it by the egg's rolled size.

egg_forest_mossy.note: Mossy Egg (Uncommon). 1 unit tall at scale 1, bottom at y = 0.

egg_forest_acorn.note: Acorn Egg (Rare). 1 unit tall at scale 1, bottom at y = 0.

pet_forest_chick.note: Chick (Common). About 1.8 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. The game scales it by weight. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1 for front legs/wings) animate automatically.

pet_forest_bunny.note: Bunny (Common). About 2.0 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. The game scales it by weight. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1 for front legs/wings) animate automatically.

pet_forest_piglet.note: Piglet (Uncommon). About 2.4 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. The game scales it by weight. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1 for front legs/wings) animate automatically.

pet_forest_fox.note: Fox (Uncommon). About 2.8 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. The game scales it by weight. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1 for front legs/wings) animate automatically.

pet_forest_owl.note: Burrowing Owl (Rare). About 3.0 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. The game scales it by weight. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1 for front legs/wings) animate automatically.

pet_forest_bear.note: Bear (Epic). About 4.8 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. The game scales it by weight. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1 for front legs/wings) animate automatically.

pet_forest_stag.note: Stag (Legendary). About 5.2 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. The game scales it by weight. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1 for front legs/wings) animate automatically.

pet_forest_spirit.note: Forest Spirit (Mythic). About 4.5 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. The game scales it by weight. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1 for front legs/wings) animate automatically.

egg_limited_nugget.note: Golden Nugget Egg (Shop Featured, limited). 1 unit tall at scale 1, bottom at y = 0.

pet_limited_goldhen.note: Golden Hen (Rare, limited). About 2.6 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1) animate automatically.

pet_limited_luckycat.note: Lucky Cat (Epic, limited). About 2.6 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1) animate automatically.

pet_limited_crystaldeer.note: Crystal Deer (Legendary, limited). About 4.6 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1) animate automatically.

pet_limited_nuggetking.note: Nugget King (Mythic, limited). About 5 units tall at its base weight, faces +Z. Leg bones LegL1/LegR1 (+ ArmL1/ArmR1) animate automatically.
